summary: Extensive background in IT management with a Master of Science and multiple certifications. Skilled in planning, implementing, and evaluating systems, infrastructure, and staffing for complex initiatives. Experienced in installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrade of networks, hardware, servers, and peripherals. Strong communication and leadership abilities, adept at vendor relations, disaster recovery, and process improvement.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Managed application database/hardware systems for Chapter 13 bankruptcy cases.
Evaluated, recommended, implemented, and troubleshot hardware and software.
Maintained LAN/WAN infrastructure, connectivity, and security.
Performed disaster recovery planning and implemented backup solutions.
Administered licenses, service contracts, and vendor visits.
Defined, documented, and updated IT procedures.
Created and maintained user accounts and email.
Inspected employee computers for policy compliance.
Coordinated special projects and network infrastructure enhancements.
Standardized hardware, peripherals, and software.
Established a helpdesk support system.
Deployed a new tracking system for performance metrics.
Implemented an enterprise backup solution with user recovery features.
Doubled WAN bandwidth and improved LAN/WLAN performance.
Automated data retrieval scripts, increasing efficiency from 35% to 87%.
Automated asset tracking using hand scanners and database systems.

experience.title: Network Analyst
responsibilities: Achieved 1,000% improvement in LAN performance by redesigning network cabling and core switch.
Led a team of five network and equipment support specialists.
Configured, maintained, and troubleshot Nortel and Juniper networks for 600 users.
Supported 200 client-server units and advanced global IT objectives.
Reduced support requests by 75%, cut equipment costs by 50%, and boosted productivity by 30% with thin client solutions.
Reduced imaging and deployment time by 60% for 40 PCs quarterly.
Planned, designed, installed, and tested wireless networks across multiple facilities.
Replaced 125 field laptops with standardized images and custom configurations.
Implemented automated pick lists and shipping documents integrated with ERP.
Trained and mentored 15 new staff members and contractors.
